folder.description: Only tasks in this folder are candidates.

recursive.description: Tasks in the folder's subfolders are candidates too.

tags_any.description: Only tasks with at least one of these tags are candidates.

tags_all.description: Only tasks with every one of these tags are candidates.

extra.description: Stored with the claim and returned with it; never interpreted.

use_token.description: Make the claim with a token, which locks the task (see Tokens).
